explanation: The border belongs to Kaliningrad, a piece of Russia on the Baltic coast. Wedged between Poland and Lithuania, it is cut off by land from the rest of Russia.

claims.text: Russia and Poland share a land border, along Russia's Kaliningrad region.
Romania, Hungary and Slovakia share no land border with Russia.
Kaliningrad is a part of Russia on the Baltic coast, between Poland and Lithuania.
Kaliningrad has no land connection to the rest of Russia.
